# Activity Types

Manage activity types in Teamleader Focus Calendar.

```php
Teamleader::activityTypes()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Calendar\ActivityTypes` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one. Every page: [`lazy()` / `cursor()`](../../guides/pagination.md#fetching-everything) |

## Endpoints

- `activityTypes.list`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `ids` | Array of activity type UUIDs |

## Examples

Get all activity types:

```php
$activityTypes = Teamleader::activityTypes()->list();
```

Get specific activity types by IDs:

```php
$activityTypes = Teamleader::activityTypes()->byIds(["uuid1", "uuid2"]);
```

Find activity type by name:

```php
$activityType = Teamleader::activityTypes()->findByName("Meeting");
```
